text.redhat: Flatpak is already there on Fedora Workstation. Check which version you have.

hint.debian: `sudo apt update` and then `sudo apt install flatpak`.

flathub.text: Add Flathub as a source (*remote*) for Flatpak.

gimp.text: Install the image editor GIMP (`org.gimp.GIMP`) from Flathub.
gimp.hint: `flatpak install flathub org.gimp.GIMP` – and answer yes.

flatpak-run.hint: Programs are started with their full ID: `flatpak run org.gimp.GIMP`

text.debian: Install the snap `hello-world` and run it. Ubuntu already has Snap; on Debian you install the package `snapd` first.
text.arch: Snap is not in the Arch repositories, only in the AUR. Build and install `snapd` from the AUR, then install the snap `hello-world` and run it.
text.redhat: Install Snap (the package `snapd`), then install the snap `hello-world` and run it.

hint.debian: `sudo apt install snapd` (only needed on Debian), `sudo snap install hello-world` and then `hello-world`.
hint.arch: `git clone https://aur.archlinux.org/snapd.git`, `cd snapd`, `makepkg -si`. Then `sudo snap install hello-world` and `hello-world`.
hint.redhat: `sudo dnf install snapd`, `sudo snap install hello-world` and then `hello-world`.

appimage-chmod.text: There is a downloaded AppImage in `~/{{downloads}}`. Make the file `{{calculator}}` executable.

appimage-run.text: Start {{calcName}}. Does it complain about FUSE? Install the missing library and try again.

hint.debian: The library is in the package `libfuse2t64`. Then start it with `~/{{downloads}}/{{calculator}}`.
hint.arch: The library is in the package `fuse2`. Then start it with `~/{{downloads}}/{{calculator}}`.
hint.redhat: The library is in the package `fuse-libs`. Then start it with `~/{{downloads}}/{{calculator}}`.
